dogecoin.text: @brian_armstrong This isn't correct. Please seek guidance to understand why. Anyone can fork BTC at any time with any amount of support. Only forks with consensus can be Bitcoin. Otherwise Dogecoin could just as easily be there true BTC if it just spams their network.

@Bitcoin It's only a scam bc you misrepresent yourself. BCash is a fork *off* the Bitcoin consensus chain... Just like litecoin, Dogecoin, etc. They are honest while you are not. I believe dishonesty will not be rewarded in the long run.

@matt_odell From the beginning it was also about the lie that a minority fork had any more validity than dogecoin. Satoshi was clear on that point, yet leaders like @brian_armstrong and @ErikVoorhees have credibility to both the false technical story & faktoshi.
